name: bilateralbound
description: A scalable real-time multiplayer game built with SOLID principles

scripts.build: echo '✅ No build step required for Node.js app'
scripts.build:pages: echo '✅ Static files are served by Node.js server' && mkdir -p dist && cp -r public/* dist/ 2>/dev/null || echo 'No public files to copy'
scripts.dev:open: PORT=3000 npm start & sleep 2 && open http://localhost:3000 && wait
scripts.test: npm run test:lint && npm run test:server
scripts.test:server: node -c server.js && echo '✅ Server syntax OK'
scripts.test:full: npm run test && npm run health-test
scripts.health-test: sleep 2 && curl -s http://localhost:3000/health | jq .status 2>/dev/null || echo '❌ Health check failed'
scripts.status: curl -s http://localhost:3000/health || echo '❌ Server not running'
scripts.quick-start: echo '🚀 Запуск сервера...' && npm run dev:open

author: BilateralBound Team
